description: How Sentry error tracking is actually wired in IntelliFlow CRM. Describes the real configuration only: no DSN value, hosts, keys, contacts or integrations are stored here. Rewritten for IFC-074 (sprint 18) to replace a template that held invented values.

dsn.managed_by: Terraform railway_variable.observability (var.sentry_dsn, sensitive; applied to Railway api and ai-worker 2026-06-08, IFC-314)

api.enabled_when: SENTRY_ENABLED is not 'false', NODE_ENV is not 'development' and SENTRY_DSN is set; otherwise a no-op with a console notice
api.error_context: tRPC tracingMiddleware sets user id, trpc.path, trpc.type and correlation.id tags and captures exceptions (apps/api/src/tracing/middleware.ts)

web.enabled_when: a DSN is set (NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN in the browser, SENTRY_DSN on server and edge); otherwise a no-op
web.notes: Error tracking only: tracing and replay are off

ai-worker.enabled_when: never: SENTRY_DSN is provisioned on the Railway service but the worker does not initialise a Sentry SDK
ai-worker.notes: Tracked as an IFC-074 finding; errors from ai-worker reach Grafana (spans with error status, ErrorRatioBreach alerts) but not Sentry

alert_routing.production_alerting: Grafana Cloud alerting (infra/monitoring/grafana/cloud/alert-rules.json and Grafana-managed App Observability rules), delivered to the owner's email contact point (IFC-032)

verification.project_exists_in_sentry: NEEDS_HUMAN: the local Sentry org token cannot list projects (HTTP 403, checked 2026-10-22); confirm in the Sentry UI
verification.dsn_set_on_railway: Terraform state (IFC-314 apply 2026-06-08); the Railway API refused a live variables read on 2026-10-22
